01 POSITION
Should we all have a voice?

We make memory move.

DekolonizArt is an independent, multidisciplinary artistic structure that uses live performances, theatre, dance, music, video, and dialogue to revisit history from African perspectives.

A decolonial work is at the center of our practice. Through powerful storytelling and artistic expression, we challenge dominant narratives and inspire critical dialogue. We believe that entertainment shall be a catalyst for growth.
